assumptions: The computed residual and update satisfy the exact operation equations corresponding to (4.1) and (4.2).
The correction residual satisfies the bound (4.14).
The residual-computation and update errors satisfy their finite Euclidean bounds.

The residual and update accuracy parameters epsilonR and epsilonU are nonnegative.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p16_t2_restarted_residual_recurrence {n : Nat} (A : P16Matrix n) (b x correction xNext rhat deltaR deltaX : P16Vector n) (epsilonR epsilonU w omega : Real) ... : p16VecNorm (p16Residual A b xNext) <= w * p16VecNorm (p16Residual A b x) + (epsilonR + epsilonU + omega) * (p16VecNorm b + p16FrobNorm A * p16VecNorm xNext)
formal_statement.plain_language: The correction residual and the finite errors in residual computation and update combine into the exact next-residual recurrence underlying Lemma 4.2.

informal_proof: Use the exact identity b-A*xNext = (rhat-A*correction)-deltaR-A*deltaX, apply Euclidean triangle inequality twice and the Frobenius action bound, replace ||x|| by ||xNext||, and collect coefficients exactly.
informal_statement: Exact finite version of Lemma 4.2's backward residual recurrence before the paper drops second-order terms.
